records.label: AI Changes the Unit of Software Work
records.summary: Defines an accepted, operable change as the unit of engineering work. The approval-routing case separates business intention, implementation, verification and acceptance, showing why brownfield understanding and explicit decision rights still matter when an AI agent generates the patch.
records.limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.

attributes.summary: Defines an accepted, operable change as the unit of engineering work. attributes.summary_it: Definisce il cambiamento accettato e gestibile come unità del lavoro ingegneristico. records.label: Limits and Capability of Coding Agents
records.summary: Turns agent capability into a bounded engineering hypothesis. Permissions, tools, budgets, stopping rules and escalation constrain execution; the chapter compares execution routes and parallel work while keeping technical completion separate from authorized acceptance.
records.limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.

records.label: Quality, Architecture and Maintainability
records.summary: Separates immediate correctness from architectural fit and maintenance obligations. Through duplication, post-merge evidence and a second change to the running service, it develops fitness checks and explicit stewardship instead of treating a passing test suite as complete quality assurance.
records.limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.

records.label: Independent Verification and the Oracle Problem
records.summary: Builds independent verification around authorized behavior. Regression cases, properties, counterexamples and mutants expose circular testing; correlated checker errors and benchmark limits motivate an evidence dossier that supports review without granting the maker acceptance authority.
records.limitation: Author engineering synthesis and teaching material; publication is not independent empirical validation.
